title.narrative: Global Train and Equip Program - CT Capability Enhancement

description.narrative: The objective of this program is to build the capacity of Burkina Fasos national military forces to conduct CT operations, including reconnaissance, insertion and extraction, hostage rescue, day and night ground operations, and interdictions. Equipment provided includes vehicles, radios, weapons accessories, ammunition, medical supplies, operational clothing and equipment, and training.
